name: Lenovo Clock Touch
description: Exposes single, double, and triple taps detected by the Lenovo Smart Clock Gen 1 accelerometer (Bosch BMA253) as Kiosk Satellite gesture triggers, with configurable sensitivity, multi-tap timing, and a live tap tester. Configure tap actions in Settings > Gestures > Add Gesture > Plugin Trigger.
author: TRusselo

settings.title: Tap sensitivity
settings.description: 1 = firmest tap, 10 = lightest tap (7 = stock 375 mg).

settings.title: Tap timing window
settings.description: How long to wait for a 2nd or 3rd tap before firing the gesture. Shorter feels faster; longer makes double and triple taps easier.

settings.title: Pause gestures while testing on this page
settings.description: While this settings page is open, taps update the tester below without triggering your mapped Gestures.
